original: Agent setup has obsolete release advice
disposition: Documentation boundary: installation/help documentation is aligned by the prior implementation; current Linux native installer gate passes. Other native platforms remain open.

original: Background maintenance is conditional in local mode
disposition: Verified mechanism and boundary: approved cadence refreshes while the owning service is running; pause/reconnect tested. No always-on claim after local owner exit.

original: One product exposes distinct agent contracts
disposition: Verified mechanisms, open adoption: query-only, managed local and shared HTTP contracts remain distinct. Local HTTP management defect repaired; actual model behavior is blocked.

original: Tool discovery does not establish adoption
disposition: Open measurement: zero completed model-driven trial turns; discovery/schema/installed acceptance do not prove adoption.

original: Bootstrap success remains a host boundary
disposition: Verified Linux bootstrap mechanism; installed-host authentication failed before model use. Cross-host success remains open.

original: Platform availability is narrower than generic agent availability
disposition: Explicit platform boundary: Linux AMD64 native archive passed; Linux ARM64/macOS targets not exercised here.

original: Multiple agents share a lifecycle constraint
disposition: Verified single-owner mechanisms: full races/native managed-agent acceptance cover contention, disconnect and reconnect; distributed writers are unsupported.

original: Project selection requires a domain translation
disposition: Open model outcome: selector/permissions mechanisms pass, but unprompted ambiguous-project selection remains unobserved.

original: Import scope has different defaults by surface
disposition: Verified mechanism: public browser/MCP scope preview parity, changed-digest rejection before registration and approved cadence.

original: Local and managed sources have different freshness meanings
disposition: Verified bounded freshness: unchanged sources reuse; edited local source is analyzed without overwriting its edit. Managed-source/full revision rules remain regression-based here.

original: Accepted work is not usable context
disposition: Verified separation: operator polls completed ingestion and then reads actual saved graph; UI and agents retain accepted/running/completed distinctions.

original: Latest completed graph is a snapshot fallback
disposition: Verified snapshot boundary: saved graph/history survive reconnect, correction rollback and restore; live edit freshness does not invalidate old saved bytes.

original: Process completion does not establish semantic completeness
disposition: Explicit semantic boundary: UI states coverage unverified; completed extraction does not imply complete architecture.

original: Public compatibility scans expose limited detection coverage
disposition: Improved measured subset: Flask 12/12 runtime operations after fixes; Boutique requires reviewed declarations. Broad independent extraction accuracy remains open.

original: Synthetic scale is separate from real extraction scale
disposition: Explicit scale boundary: 150 synthetic services exercise rendering and selection; eight public scopes and the Flask tutorial exercise extraction. No equivalence or production throughput claim.

original: Declared and extracted relationships have different meanings
disposition: Verified provenance: 12 correction edges stay pack-declared and HTTP/MCP evidence agrees; other source-extracted edges remain distinct.

original: Teaching is an ongoing governance activity
disposition: Verified governance mechanism: actual gap transitions, editor report/admin activation boundaries and correction rollback. No automatic promotion of a suggested pack.

original: Static source is not runtime truth
disposition: Explicit evidence boundary: source/declaration findings cannot prove runtime traffic or dynamic configuration.

original: Whole-view graph labels can become visually small
disposition: Verified bounded readability: keyboard search/focus and tablet/phone graph geometry pass; large graphs still require pan, team scope or search.

original: Workspace operations vocabulary is crowded
disposition: Implemented interaction boundary: primary Update context, role-aware actions and responsive wrapping are exercised. Independent evidence that the vocabulary is simple enough remains open.

original: First project creation limits exploratory control
disposition: Verified regression mechanisms: approved import review/continuation and first-use component tests pass. Newcomer completion without coaching remains unmeasured.

original: Project-list failure also produces an empty list
disposition: Verified regression boundary: loading/empty/error/denied state tests pass; current normal-state browser scans do not retest every network fault.

original: Shared dialogs lack several expected interaction behaviors
disposition: Verified live: both modal systems have names, focus containment, Escape and restoration; extraction form labels repaired.

original: Graph keyboard interaction is uneven
disposition: Verified keyboard subset: dashboard graph selection and scroll access plus extractor dialog/activity/graph scroll focus. Real screen-reader navigation remains untested.

original: Detail views bound how much evidence is visible
disposition: Verified inspector subset: selected service details are reachable on desktop/short phone; exhaustive evidence-expansion behavior remains covered by existing tests and prior live records.

original: PR impact is not an automatic code-host review lifecycle
disposition: Explicit product boundary: PR evidence is on demand. No automatic upstream warning/comment delivery was configured or claimed.

original: Exact PR evidence requires matching clean revision
disposition: Verified mechanisms: clean controlled head/caller qualifies; stale/missing patch/dirty caller does not; actual upstream PR is stale. Independent corpus acceptance remains open.

original: PR scores are heuristics with no demonstrated calibration
disposition: Explicit uncertainty: heuristic labels remain visible; no score calibration or merge-safety claim. Human interpretation remains open.

original: Removed and indirectly changed behavior remain a PR evidence limit
disposition: Verified conservative subset: deleted old line cannot match unchanged head; internal helper effects require supported evidence. Independent deletion/transitive corpus remains open.

original: Import and PR provider scope may diverge
disposition: Verified public/controlled boundary: actual GitHub PR and local-only repository states visible; provider host tests pass. Actual Enterprise deployment remains open.

original: Browser identity does not automatically connect the agent
disposition: Verified contract boundary: browser and agent credentials remain separate; scoped handoff/installed-client tests pass. Actual company client/model trial remains external.

original: Project access does not mirror code-host repository permissions
disposition: Verified disclosure and authorization: project-wide visibility is shown; code-host repository ACL mirroring is not promised.

original: Scoped company access must be deliberately enabled
disposition: Verified live activation: legacy mode stays unchanged until explicit restart with scoped mode; grants survive and ungranted access is denied.

original: Correction authority is centralized in scoped mode
disposition: Verified authority: editor can report gaps but cannot activate a pack; admin performs reviewed activation.

original: Offboarding spans independent grants
disposition: Verified independent grants: membership and assigned-token revocation both required; unrelated service/admin grant survives. Human support-owner understanding unmeasured.

original: Recovery restores authority as well as architecture
disposition: Verified live on both backends: restore reproduces old authority and operator reconciles it before ordinary ingress; graph and rollback preserved.

original: Persistence is a single-server operating contract
disposition: Verified operating boundary: single-server writer ownership, queue/history and backup lock guards pass; no HA/distributed-writer claim.

original: Operational measures are not user-outcome measures
disposition: Open measurement: retained timing/test outcomes are operator evidence; no retention, support-load or independent usability outcome was measured.

original: Graph differences can have multiple causes
disposition: Verified bounded provenance: correction changes/reuse/rollback preserve snapshots and evidence; existing snapshot-diff tests pass.

original: Old evaluation instructions remain discoverable
disposition: Documentation updated: testing index now points at this exact candidate report; historical reports stay dated and are not treated as current proof.

original: Existing tests prove important mechanisms within bounded fixtures
disposition: Explicit testing boundary: new live trials found bugs despite a green baseline suite. Regression and negative-control evidence is retained; untested cases stay visible.

original: Actual behavior of target personas remains unmeasured
disposition: Open measurement: zero independent participants; three observations per original persona are still required.

original: Dry-run discovery returned six candidates but the dashboard closed without displaying them.
disposition: Verified live preview: reviewed browser/MCP candidates and digest agree; preview does not register sources.

original: Reopening import after preview reset the directory and dry-run state.
disposition: Verified continuation mechanisms: filter changes invalidate review; stale candidate digest rejected; draft-retention component coverage remains green.

original: Invalid-root validation returned an exact error outside the still-open modal, visually behind its overlay.
disposition: Verified validation mechanism: invalid-root response and existing inline form-error tests pass; no new human error-recovery observation.

original: First-use modal had no dialog role, initial field focus or focus containment; Name lacked the tested accessible name.
disposition: Verified live in both interfaces: named dialogs and inputs, keyboard boundary and focus restoration.

original: Absolute-path dashboard launch succeeded while its analysis subprocess failed without `diffmind` on PATH; process-environment recovery succeeded.
disposition: Verified native gate: installed binary runs without source-checkout PATH assumptions; embedded UI and managed analysis pass.

original: Default local session preserved the old graph after five seconds and reconnect; disconnect stopped its dashboard, while saved state survived.
disposition: Verified lifecycle boundary: approved refresh/reuse/pause and saved-state reconnect pass while a service owner exists.

original: Initial gateway label measured six pixels high; search/focus raised it to 16 pixels.
disposition: Verified graph subset: public labels and synthetic search/keyboard selection; repaired phone viewport clipping. Human orientation remains unmeasured.

original: The tested UI graph comparison displayed five modified facts; the agent contract tool displayed four field changes with compatibility labels.
disposition: Verified regression boundary: contract compatibility and snapshot comparison tests pass; prior live contract report remains historical, not a new independent interpretation result.

original: Local synthetic repositories produced a zero-PR filtered view with a generic scope empty state.
disposition: Verified actual public/local UI states: Flask provider queried while synthetic caller is explicitly local-only; no fictitious zero-impact result.

original: Initial no-access guidance explained the need for a grant; live grant removal left a generic not-found page. Access itself was removed.
disposition: Verified bounded access lifecycle: recovery/offboarding API outcomes plus access-loss component tests; independent returning-user comprehension remains open.

original: Default public-repository analysis attributed Demo Shop examples/scenarios to `diffmind`, including queue facts in PR technical context.
disposition: Verified scope/provenance mechanisms: approved source scope and declaration provenance tested; root-versus-subdirectory independent corpus is still not fully executed.
